Schnittstelle Fun3<X1,X2,X3,Y>

Typparameter:
X1 - the type of the first argument
X2 - the type of the second argument
X3 - the type of the third argument
Y - the result type
Alle Superschnittstellen:
Deferrable3<X1,X2,X3,Y>
Alle bekannten Unterschnittstellen:
Operator3<A>
Funktionsschnittstelle:
Dies ist eine funktionale Schnittstelle, die somit als Zuweisungsziel für einen Lambdaausdruck oder eine Methodenreferenz verwendet werden kann.
@FunctionalInterface public interface Fun3<X1,X2,X3,Y> extends Deferrable3<X1,X2,X3,Y>

A functional interface for ternary functions. Provides utilities for composition, currying, partial application, and deferral with strict non-null contracts.

Contract: unless stated otherwise, inputs must not be null and results must not be null.

  • Methodendetails

    • apply

      @Pure @NonNull Y apply(@NonNull X1 x1, @NonNull X2 x2, @NonNull X3 x3)

      Applies this function to the given arguments.

      Contract: inputs must not be null; the result must not be null.

      Parameter:
      x1 - the first argument; must not be null
      x2 - the second argument; must not be null
      x3 - the third argument; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      the result; never null

    • andThen

      default <Z> @NonNull Fun3<X1,X2,X3,Z> andThen(@NonNull Function<? super Y, ? extends Z> next)

      Composes this function with a post-processing step: applies this and then next.

      Contract: next must not be null; intermediate and final results must not be null.

      Typparameter:
      Z - the result type of next
      Parameter:
      next - the function to apply after this one; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a composed Fun3 that applies this and then next
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if next is null or any intermediate result is null

    • defer

      default @NonNull Callable<Y> defer(@NonNull Supplier<X1> a1, @NonNull Supplier<X2> a2, @NonNull Supplier<X3> a3)
      Beschreibung aus Schnittstelle kopiert: Deferrable3

      Returns an executable handle that, when called, obtains the three inputs from the given suppliers and performs the computation to produce the result.

      Contract: all suppliers must not be null and must not supply null values. The returned handle must not return null.

      Angegeben von:
      defer in Schnittstelle Deferrable3<X1,X2,X3,Y>
      Parameter:
      a1 - a Supplier providing the first input; must not be null
      a2 - a Supplier providing the second input; must not be null
      a3 - a Supplier providing the third input; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a Callable performing the deferred computation

    • partial1

      default @NonNull Fun2<X2,X3,Y> partial1(@NonNull Supplier<X1> supplier)

      Partially applies this function by supplying the first argument via a Supplier. Returns a binary function over the remaining arguments.

      Contract: the supplier and its value must not be null; the result must not be null.

      Parameter:
      supplier - supplier for x1; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a binary function over x2 and x3
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if the supplier or its value is null, or the result is null

    • partial2

      default @NonNull Fun2<X1,X3,Y> partial2(@NonNull Supplier<X2> supplier)

      Partially applies this function by supplying the second argument via a Supplier. Returns a binary function over the remaining arguments.

      Contract: the supplier and its value must not be null; the result must not be null.

      Parameter:
      supplier - supplier for x2; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a binary function over x1 and x3
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if the supplier or its value is null, or the result is null

    • partial3

      default @NonNull Fun2<X1,X2,Y> partial3(@NonNull Supplier<X3> supplier)

      Partially applies this function by supplying the third argument via a Supplier. Returns a binary function over the remaining arguments.

      Contract: the supplier and its value must not be null; the result must not be null.

      Parameter:
      supplier - supplier for x3; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a binary function over x1 and x2
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if the supplier or its value is null

    • curry

      default @NonNull Fun<X1, Fun<X2, Fun<X3,Y>>> curry()

      Curries this ternary function into a chain of unary functions.

      Contract: inputs and all intermediate results must not be null.

      Gibt zurück:
      the curried representation of this function

    • uncurry

      static <X1,X2,X3,Y> Fun3<X1,X2,X3,Y> uncurry(@NonNull Function<X1, Function<X2, Function<X3,Y>>> curried)

      Uncurries a curried ternary function into a Fun3.

      Contract: curried must not be null; none of the intermediate results may be null.

      Typparameter:
      X1 - the type of the first argument
      X2 - the type of the second argument
      X3 - the type of the third argument
      Y - the result type
      Parameter:
      curried - the curried function to uncurry; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a Fun3 representing the uncurried function
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if curried is null or any intermediate result is null
